findings.summary: Milestone M1 claims to satisfy acceptance test AT2 (Static Site Generation), but AT2 requires verifying features (search, tags, backlinks) that are not implemented until M2, M3, and M4. This creates a risk that violations of the static-site constraint introduced in later milestones go undetected if AT2 is not re-executed.

evidence.note: M1 exit criteria claims AT2 passes
evidence.quote: AT2 passes: output is static files only; site viewable via static file server.

evidence.note: AT2 requires testing search, tags, and backlinks which are not in M1
evidence.quote: site functions without any server-side runtime for browsing, search, tags, or backlinks.

evidence.note: M1 deliverables do not include search, tags, or backlinks

findings.summary: Deterministic sample checks for R1–R3 list milestones ["M1","M2"], but the plan’s M2 milestone scope is forward links/backlinks; there is no explicit additional implementation/verification of R1–R3 in M2 beyond what is already gated in M1. This milestone mapping may be misleading unless M2 is intended as an explicit regression re-check milestone for these requirements.

evidence.note: Sample check includes M2 for R1
Sample check includes M2 for R2
Sample check includes M2 for R3
M1 explicitly includes acceptance tests covering AT1/AT2/AT3 (R1/R2/R3)
evidence.quote: Fixture-based acceptance tests for AT1, AT2, AT3, AT4, AT13.

evidence.note: M2 is scoped to forward links/backlinks

findings.summary: Sample check for R3 (Markdown parse/render fidelity) does not reflect the dependency on resolving Q1 (Markdown flavor/link syntax). The plan treats Q1 as blocking before M1 work begins; without capturing this dependency in the trace sample, R3 may be treated as schedulable/verifiable before its specification prerequisite is resolved.

evidence.note: R3 sample check lacks explicit dependency on Q1
Q1 is blocking and includes Markdown flavor decision affecting rendering expectations
evidence.quote: What Markdown flavor and internal link syntax should be supported for links/backlinks (CommonMark/GFM; standard Markdown links, Obsidian-style [[WikiLinks]], both)?

evidence.note: Plan gates milestone work on resolving Q1/Q2 first
evidence.quote: Blocking questions Q1 and Q2 resolved and documented before milestone work begins.
